cohort: Pregnant adolescents (14-19 years) who tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 between April 2020 and December 2020 at Inova Health System Hospitals, compared with pregnant adolescents who tested negative during the same period
finding: Pregnant adolescents infected with SARS-CoV-2 are more likely to experience adverse obstetric outcomes and maternal morbidity compared to uninfected pregnant adolescents.
